automation-trigger-inventory.title: Trigger families and what limits them
automation-trigger-inventory.description: Schedules, repository events, chained runs and manual or API runs differ in who starts the run and what limits its writes. Scheduled runs ignore write scope.

api-and-assignment-entry-points.title: Programmatic routes into agent work
api-and-assignment-entry-points.description: Four routes start unattended agent work. Each carries its own credential, acting identity and payer, so inventory all three per route.

personal-vs-shared-identity.title: Personal and shared automations compared
personal-vs-shared-identity.description: The automation type is fixed at creation and decides visibility, editing, billing and the identity used for actions on GitHub.

ownership-and-continuity.title: Ownership lifecycle for an automation
ownership-and-continuity.description: Create, run and discover an automation, then review its owner, recreate a personal routine as shared and retire the old one.

tool-and-write-scope.title: Layers that shape what a run can reach
tool-and-write-scope.description: Selected tools are the primary control, then write scope, inherited repository configuration and the prompt. Each layer has gaps the others must cover.

untrusted-input-and-chaining.title: Which events can start a run
untrusted-input-and-chaining.description: An event starts a run only if its actor has write access and it was not created by Copilot, unless the automation opts in. Resulting pull requests wait for workflow approval.

credit-limits-and-billing.title: How credit limits play out over one day
credit-limits-and-billing.description: In a hypothetical hourly automation, per-run limits cap each run, the run that crosses the daily limit can finish, and later runs are blocked until the daily reset.

run-volume-and-rate-control.title: Levers for run volume and API rate
run-volume-and-rate-control.description: Cadence, filters, serialization and credit limits shape how often runs start. Scripts that start runs must follow REST rate limit guidance.

review-and-workflow-gates.title: Review gates on an automation pull request
review-and-workflow-gates.description: Copilot pushes to one branch and opens a draft pull request. A writer approves workflow runs, people review, and branch rules require the approvals before merge.

pause-disable-and-revoke.title: Pick the switch that matches the scope
pause-disable-and-revoke.description: Stop one session, disable one automation, turn off automations for an organization, or use the enterprise policy. Then verify and revoke script tokens.

run-evidence-and-audit.title: Trace one automation run
run-evidence-and-audit.description: Follow a commit to its session log and automation page, match audit log events and task records, and join them into one evidence trace.

automation-change-control.title: Review changes to automation definitions
automation-change-control.description: Edits and proposals land in revision history outside Git. Compare snapshots, let the owner review, keep an approved baseline, and move to agentic workflows when pull request review is required.
